status.en: 119 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Islamabad, Peshawar and Kabul.
status.nb: 119 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Islamabad, Peshawar og Kabul.

summary.en: Pakistani security forces again foiled a cross-border infiltration attempt in Upper Kurram, killing the attackers and destroying their posts, while Afghan Taliban members were arrested in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. A bus-truck collision on the Hazara Motorway killed eight people and injured thirty, and a separate crash in Punjab killed eleven and injured thirty-three, adding to recent transport fatalities. NADRA officials were targeted in Peshawar, where one officer was killed and another was shot near his office. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker avverget igjen et grenseoverskridende infiltrasjonsforsøk i Upper Kurram, drepte angriperne og ødela deres poster, mens afghanske Taliban-medlemmer ble arrestert i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. En buss-lastebil-kollisjon på Hazara-motorveien drepte åtte personer og såret tretti, og en separat ulykke i Punjab drepte elleve og såret tretti-tre, noe som øker de siste transportdødsfallene. NADRA-ansatte ble målrettet i Peshawar, hvor en offiser ble drept og en annen ble skutt nær kontoret sitt. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
